profile.headline: Software Engineer, Product Enablement Tools at NetApp
profile.summary:
Experienced Data Manager who gathers technical specifications and requirements from internal stakeholders across multiple teams. Proficient in performing CRUD operations, writing stored procedures, and utilizing pyodbc and pandas for data entry and reporting.

I am adaptable, passionate, and always willing to learn something new.  Feel free to contact me if you have any questions!

positions.title: Software Engineer, Product Enablement Tools
positions.description:
• Communicated with 20+ product owners in an Agile Workflow, utilizing JIRA to document requirements for the data team and users of Hardware Universe.
• Developed and implemented efficient data managements processes to provide technical specifications for 30+ internal tools.
• Led a data management team in developing and implementing streamlined QA processes to generate accurate sizing information for NetApp and OEM partners.
• Effectively managed customer tickets for Hardware Universe, delivering valuable insights about NetApp products through proactive communication and collaboration with product owners.
• Conducted in-depth analysis of the Enterprise Product Information Center (EPIC) and executed SQL queries to efficiently perform CRUD operations for Product Launches.
• Collaborated daily with technical and subject matter experts to maintain and input new product data.
• Utilized Python to parse websites, text files, and spreadsheets, successfully loading thousands of rows into the EPIC database.

positions.title: Contract Data Analyst (Part-Time)
positions.description:
• Assisted Chief Science Officer with analysis of human insight surveys
• Proficient in R and used tidyr, dplyr, plyr, readr, readxl, and ggplot2 packages
• Advanced understanding of data manipulation and strong ability to solve complex problems

positions.title: SAS Programmer
positions.description:
Generated Reports, Listings, and Graphs required to generate reports for  non-clinical (animal studies) and Clinical Trials

Experience in Pharmaceutical Data manipulation and producing reports employing various SAS procedures like PROC SQL, PROC REPORT, PROC FREQ, PROC UNIVARIATE, PROC MEANS, and PROC CONTENTS

Experience in creating/validating SDTM and ADaM according to CDISC standards

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description:
Maintained high standards of customer service during high-volume, fast-paced operations
Followed procedures for safe food preparation, assembly, and presentation 
Handled currency and credit transactions quickly and accurately

positions.title: Data Entry Specialist
positions.description:
Mitigated over 3000+ misentries within the original data for clinical research trials.

Verified the data entry accuracy before the data would be submitted to the FDA. 

Used to ClinPlus Software to enter, verify, and query pharmaceutical data.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: KCSU, Colorado State University Student Radio
volunteerExperiences.description:
Organized interviews with local and touring artists such as Post Paradise, Head Injuries, Places Back Home, Trizz, G-Mo Skee, and youth artists from the Rising Artist Mentorship Program (RAMP)

Promoted RAMP by working alongside KRFC to host a weekly interview with youth artists, musicians, and bands.

Reviewed and played College Music Journal music, and discussed sports, politics, and events and issues occurring locally.

company.name: KCSU, Colorado State University Student Radio

volunteerExperiences.description:
Coached for the Fort Collins Parks and Rec 4th/5th grade boys basketball league.

Taught fundamentals, sportsmanship, and conditioning to 10 players, and practiced and played twice a week. 

Enjoyed working with the young athletes and improving their skills in basketball.
